newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland to take part in European Business Survey.
newsitem.headline: Poland to take part in European Business Survey.

text.p: Small and mid-size Polish firms will take part in the European Business Survey conducted by auditors Grant Thornton International, an official from one of the associated auditing firms said on Wednesday.
Andrzej Kinast, the head of Potworowski Kinast Grant Thornton, said Poland will appear on a pilot basis in the 1997 business servey and serve as a full member from 1998.
"Tomorrow we will send surveys to 200 firms...in the pilot programme...(and) our goal is (to poll) about 2000 firms in 1998," Kinast told a news conference.
The European Business Survey was started four years ago and encompases some 5,200 firms from 17 countries, mainly European Union members.
